item.title: Implement atomic ledger API and focused tests
item.brief: Implement ledger.py exactly according to SPEC.md, preserving the documented API and standard-library-only constraint. Add focused tests beyond the basics for every specified error and boundary case: constructor validation and defensive copying, amount validation before account lookup, unknown accounts, insufficient funds, destination overflow, same-account transfers (including MAX_BALANCE), unchanged state on all failures, snapshots not aliasing internal state, total preservation, and deterministic thread safety/linearizability with no deadlock on opposite transfers. Keep tests deterministic, without external services, wall-clock calculations, or random inputs. Run the repository's tests and any appropriate checks. Commit the completed work. Acceptance: implementation matches every SPEC.md clause; focused tests exercise all listed behaviors; checks pass; commit is present.

Expanded test_ledger.py for constructor validation and copying, amount validation order, unknown accounts, insufficient funds, overflow and same-account boundaries, unchanged failures, total preservation, snapshot isolation, and concurrent opposite transfers. Verified with `python -m unittest -v` (10 passed) and `git diff --check` on 1f08c26e3cef38c062c2ad9187836cba0cc5ccb8. Assumption: built-in dict validation follows SPEC; no external dependencies.
